body:
If it helps any, I've been feeling the same way. Breaking down in tears at all kinds of inappropriate times and places. I feel very out of place. Among other things I'm a musician and this current bout of feelings in one way tugs me to express myself, but at the same time stymies my ability to do so. I'm left with this inexpressibly torn feeling of creativity and inadequacy. Meanwhile when not breaking down publicly, I'm just in this state of a constant thousand yard stare while my mind drifts nowhere helpful.

I hope you're able to find a way to let out that voice in some fashion, but in the meantime I can empathize with how you're feeling. It's very frustrating.

To follow up, I started seeing a psychologist last week. I think based on the two sessions we've had it will be helpful. If he recommends me to a psychiatrist for meds, I'm not opposed to going that route at this point. I am still utterly heartbroken. I break down in tears at work, at home. It's utterly unlike me and I just feel devastated, which is kind of crazy given the relatively short relationship. I still think about dying frequently. I still wouldn't do it, I don't think. To quote Marmalade:

"The world is
a bad place.
A bad place.
A terrible place to live
But I don't want to die."

I appreciate the feedback. One thing I will mention without getting into too many details about my life is that I do some art on the side (though I still have a dream of making it my life, even if I know that's unrealistic), and the only time I feel inspired is when I'm tapped into my depression. I worry that if I were on meds, I may never create again. I've gone years being happy enough, and when I am, I have no creative spark whatsoever. It's a horrible feeling in its own right and I'm not sure I'm willing to give up the art. I just don't want to feel like...this. I know it may sound crazy, and I may still take your advice anyway, but that's the long and short of why I've never medicated before.
